headline:
Made with intention,
stitched with love
paragraphs: Every piece in our collection starts with a single strand of yarn and a hook. We source only the finest cotton, wool, and acrylic yarn, soft enough for babies, durable enough for everyday use.
Each item is made to order, which means it's crafted fresh just for you. No mass production, no shortcuts, only genuine handmade work delivered with care.

founders.name: Sailee Bhagwat
bio: The hands behind every stitch, Sailee started crocheting as a stress-buster and turned it into a full creative practice.
She specialises in amigurumi, baby wear, and custom gifting with a love for clean, earthy aesthetics.

founders.name: Prerna Patil
bio: Prerna is the creative mind behind the brand's social media, customer experience and online presence.
She loves turning Sailee's handmade creations into a brand that people can discover, connect with, and love.
